paragraphs.text: Rip is a human survivor and experienced monster hunter living on Duskmourn .

Known for her quiet and solitary nature, Rip is a hardened veteran who prefers to face monsters alone. She is most at ease when engaged in combat, often dispatching creatures with brutal efficiency. Her arsenal includes a custom-made technological device that delivers powerful electric shocks, alongside a traditional flamethrower. Scarred from countless battles fought within the House , Rip carries the hard-earned knowledge that fallen foes must always be burned, lest they return twisted and dangerous. While in her youth she carefully recorded details of the creatures she encountered, in her later years she has adopted a simpler approach: killing them with fire.

Many survivor groups on Duskmourn can recount stories of being saved by Rip or finding new safe havens she cleared of monster infestations and stocked with vital supplies. Previously, Rip was a member of the Doorblades , a small band of hunters committed to eradicating the monsters plaguing the House. However, she eventually parted ways with them after realizing that the bonds she formed were dulling her instincts and effectiveness as a hunter. Despite her discomfort, Rip has earned the nickname "the savior of the House" from those who owe their lives to her skill and bravery.
Rip is possibly inspired by Ripley of Alien fame.
